scope: One bounded transport candidate: 33 actual 512-bit LTP1 FIFO pops, complete LAD1/A and old held K reference checks, physical route, the complete 512B expected action, full LTX identity/model against old A, and all 1536 actual source LTX bytes against the retained original FSM snapshot. Only then are immutable original bytes offered on the existing adapter ap_fifo interface, with a separate 24 actual adapter-peer pops. Three real depth2 FIFOs provide metadata, source LTX and an opaque 16-word controlled LTC return whose actual caller pops alone release the candidate. Thirty-three reset-separated cases cover all three ordinary kinds including RELEASE, cancel before first metadata pop, persistent revocation/live changes, 33/24 prefixes, adapter and LTC tail2/tail1 waits12, one matching real second candidate without reset and with persistent revoke, wrong A/K/physical route/full action/header/identity/model/source bytes and no invented HOLD. Independent LTP host01 literals and whole byte actual host codec oracles are frozen; existing owned-program host04 full GRANTED/LAP literals supply the controlled old K and expected LAX. The production expected-action export from the actual LAP consumer is not connected in this pilot. FSM exporter, A/K/LAP consumers and adapter/F10/sidecar peers are controlled. candidate_verified is transport equality only: full LTX syntax/reserved semantic/canonical parsing and exact remote cleanup authorization remain with the actual managed adapter and sole hub, neither run here. No LTC codec/LOCAL_REJECT, hub cleanup permission/terminal, publication, allocation, retirement, same-runtime C, CLOSED/rearm, resources/timing/board claim. Route0 is a controlled no-HOLD predecessor source, not a wired real predecessor FSM pending outlet. No reset or FIFO clear within a case.
